subject: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and target $/1M
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and target $/1M

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can size pricing and options accurately.

Recap from the call:
- Use cases discussed: customer support automation (chat), semantic search/enrichment (embeddings), content reranking for recommendations (rerank).
- Target latency SLOs: ~200–400ms for chat, <100ms for embeddings lookups (we noted some flexibility if batched).
- Expected launch: pilot in Q2, ramp through Q3.

Asks / data we need to finalize a draft quote and unit economics:
1) Monthly token volumes (example: avg tokens per chat session, sessions/day) for each model type: chat / embeddings / rerank. If you can share per-feature splits that’s ideal.
2) Target budget range or pull for the pilot and steady-state (monthly). You mentioned a cadence for a $30k–$60k/mo range on the call — can you confirm?
3) Any hard constraints on encryption/KMS or data residency we should include in the SOW?
4) Preferred billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly) and whether you need PO/contractual billing.

I attached a token-estimate worksheet that our solutions team uses — fill in the green columns or send a quick note with per-model monthly volumes and we’ll return a back-of-envelope target $/1M tokens and an initial model-mix pricing plan.

Next steps:
- Sophie: send estimated volumes + confirm budget range (by EOD Wed 02/03)
- Redwood (me + Rishi): provide BOE unit economics, two pricing tiers (pilot/committed) and a draft SOW.
- If numbers look aligned, propose 30-minute pricing review the week of 02/08.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and target $/1M

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — this is very helpful. I filled out the token estimates sheet and attached it ("BrightLayer_Monthly_Token_Estimates.xlsx"). Below are the high-level numbers from our side for the pilot and expected steady-state.

Pilot (months 1–3):
- Chat (customer support): ~1.2M tokens/month (avg ~600 tokens per session, ~2k sessions/month)
- Embeddings (semantic search + enrichment): ~600k tokens/month (we do vectorization + occasional reruns)
- Rerank (relevance layer for recommendations): ~200k tokens/month
- Total pilot tokens: ~2.0M/month

Steady-state (months 6+):
- Chat: 10M tokens/month
- Embeddings: 3M tokens/month
- Rerank: 1M tokens/month
- Total steady-state: ~14M/month

Budget: for pilot we can commit $30k–$45k/mo. Post-pilot, target budget is $60k–$90k/mo depending on model performance and unit cost.

Target unit economics: we’d like to see an approx target of $600–$800 per 1M tokens for chat in pilot (we understand embeddings/rerank have different cost profiles). If you can provide per-model $/1M targets (pilot vs committed) that’d be great.

Notes: we’ll need standard SOC2 evidence — procurement will request the security questionnaire and a short KMS note. Data residency is US only for this first phase.

Happy to hop on a call to walk through the workbook if that’s easier.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Head of Platform Partnerships | BrightLayer
Sophie.Turner@brightlayer.io

Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and target $/1M

Hi Sophie —

Great — thanks for the granular volumes and the workbook. A few quick thoughts and an initial back-of-envelope (BOE) based on the numbers you sent.

BOE unit economics (pilot vs committed, per 1M tokens):
- Chat (LLM generation): Pilot: ~$700 / 1M tokens; Committed (6–12mo): $480 / 1M tokens (tiered at volumes above 5M/mo)
- Embeddings: Pilot: ~$250 / 1M tokens (one-time vectorization mix); Committed: ~$180 / 1M tokens with batching/quantization optimizations
- Rerank: Pilot: ~$420 / 1M tokens; Committed: ~$300 / 1M tokens

Using your steady-state split (chat 10M / embeddings 3M / rerank 1M = 14M):
- Pilot expected spend (2M/mo at pilot rates): approx $1,400 (chat 1.2M * 700) + $150 (embeddings 0.6M * 250) + $84 (rerank 0.2M * 420) => roughly $1.6k for the pilot month tokens.
- Note: these BOEs are token-only compute estimates; we’ll include overheads (reserved capacity / SLA / storage for embeddings) in the formal quote which is why the total pilot spend you quoted ($30k–$45k) is higher — that covers reserved nodes, support, and SLO guarantees.

Questions to confirm:
- Should we price embeddings both for offline vectorization (one-time) and online indexing/refresh separately?
- Do you expect a large proportion of chat to be streaming responses (higher token counts but lower p99 latency requirements)?

Next steps:
- I’ll turn this BOE into two pricing options: pilot (pay-as-you-go + short committed uplift) and committed (12-mo reserved capacity + lower $/1M).
- Draft SOW and an initial quote attached (SOW_Draft_v2.pdf).
- Can we schedule a 30-min pricing review on Feb 9 or 10? I’ll propose times after I hear which day works.

Looping Rishi to help with the quote and procurement language.

Thanks —
Marissa
